issue.title: Serialize the capture_pomodoros BOB_DAY_FILE test mutation
issue.description:
`capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes` reads the process-global `BOB_DAY_FILE` while `tests::with_env` in the same module sets and clears that variable with no lock.

`capture_complete::tests` already documents the race and holds `DAY_FILE_LOCK` around every day-file override (`src/native/capture_complete.rs`, the static just above `day_file_guard`). That mutex is private to the module, so `capture_pomodoros` cannot take it. Lib tests share one process, so a `capture_complete` test can set `BOB_DAY_FILE` while the pomodoros missing-note test expects the default day file to be absent (or the reverse).

bob-cli-2c.1 proposed quarantining or serializing these env-mutating tests. The helper and the test predate this epic: both are from `cc4c9a38` (2026-08-28), "feat(capture): list pomodoro ledger entries". This landing did not catch a fresh fail-then-pass run; the defect is the unlocked mutation, which is visible in the two `with_env` implementations.

Share one process-wide lock (the private `DAY_FILE_LOCK` does not serialize across modules) or stop the pomodoros test from mutating the environment. Do not treat this as part of epic bob-cli-2c.

task_type_fields.impact: Parallel `cargo test --lib` can fail a warning-success assertion that has been in tree since 2026-08-28, or can hide a real missing-note failure by pointing the test at another test's day file. The start epic's own suite is unaffected when tests run serially.
task_type_fields.repro: Read `src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs` `tests::with_env` (sets `BOB_DAY_FILE` via `std::env::set_var` with no mutex) and `missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes`, which calls `list_capture_pomodoros` once with the ambient env and once inside `with_env`. Then read `src/native/capture_complete.rs` `tests::DAY_FILE_LOCK`: the comment says parallel tests must never set and read `BOB_DAY_FILE` at the same time, and `day_file_guard` is module-private. `rg BOB_DAY_FILE src/native/capture_complete.rs` shows many tests take that lock; the pomodoros test does not. A parallel `cargo test --lib` can therefore observe another test's day file during the missing-note assertion. This landing did not re-run that suite to time a failure.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-2c.1 proposed serializing the capture_pomodoros BOB_DAY_FILE test mutation. The unlocked process-global write predates that epic and is not caused by the Pomodoro start work, so it is a separate bug.

evidence.note: bob-cli-2z.1 and bob-cli-2z.2 independently reported the same parallel-only missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failure on a clean base; source audit confirms capture_pomodoros::tests::with_env mutates process-global BOB_DAY_FILE without the shared DAY_FILE_LOCK used by capture_complete tests. It passes serially; the race predates bob-cli-2z and is unrelated to typed close logs.

bob-cli-34.5 (priority roll decay docs phase, epic bob-cli-34) independently hit missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failing once in a full just test run on 2026-10-01, then passing on rerun and in isolation; its change only added a config-parse test in src/native/config/mod.rs, so the failure is the same parallel BOB_DAY_FILE race, unrelated to that epic.

Landing bob-cli-3b: proposals from bob-cli-3b.1 note #1 (capture_complete missing-day flake), bob-cli-3b.2 note #1, and bob-cli-3b.3 note #1 (capture_pomodoros missing-note flakes) share this existing BOB_DAY_FILE race. Independent source audit on e77bbe3 confirms capture_pomodoros.rs:1189 first reads ambient process env and :1277 with_env sets/removes BOB_DAY_FILE without a mutex; capture_complete.rs:2119 uses a module-private DAY_FILE_LOCK inaccessible to pomodoros tests. Phase .2/.3 report failure on clean base and success alone; no fresh failure run claimed by this lander. One shared process-wide environment guard/removal fixes both sides, so no duplicate task filed.

Independent repro from the bob-cli-3f landing (proposed by bob-cli-3f.5 as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP): on master 447e97d plus the land diff, full 'cargo test --lib' failed this test 5 of 5 runs (assert_eq!(missing.count, 0) at capture_pomodoros.rs:1196, left 1 right 0: the ambient-env first call saw another test's BOB_DAY_FILE). It passes in isolation. At the pre-epic commit 5d24c98 it failed 1 of 3 full lib runs, so the race predates bob-cli-3f. Impact: 'just all' / 'cargo test' now fails nearly every run on athena, and the failing lib binary stops cargo before the CLI integration tests run unless --no-fail-fast is used. capture_pomodoros tests::with_env still sets BOB_DAY_FILE with no lock while capture_complete holds its module-private DAY_FILE_LOCK.
